Name: Sexworker Alex Dialogue Mod
Author: Udunie
Description:
Heyo!

This is my second mod, inspired by the various 'lewd dialogue' mods that a lot of the Stardew Valley ladies already have, and
it features sexworker!Alex!
It's not a complete overwrite of his dialogue, just adds a little spice to him without being too much (at least I hope)...

The mod includes the following changes:
- slightly rewrites Alex's two, four and six heart events
- rewrites/adds new dialogue to Alex (mostly from 4 hearts and up)

The mod is for 1.6  and up and should work with any portrait mods, and
probably with dialogue mods too, but it hasn't been tested with other
stuff... I think it can work with any farmer gender, but would work best
with male or gnc farmer.

Anyway, I hope you guys will enjoy it, and let me know if there are any problems/errors and I will try to work it out.

I'm not promising anything, but if you have any requests regarding lewd dialogue mods for any of the bachelors, let me know!

You can find my Camboy!Sebastian mod here: [url=http://]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23316[/url]
